Privacy Policy & Data Governance

Last Updated: 18 October 2026 · Effective Date: Private Beta Launch

1. Fundamental Core Principle: Zero Raw Audio Retention

Kavach is engineered around the principle of data minimization. When an elder takes a phone call on speakerphone in the presence of a Kavach tabletop tablet:

  • Raw audio chunks (16 kHz PCM) are buffered only in volatile system RAM to extract speech-to-text transcripts.
  • Raw microphone audio is NEVER saved to permanent disk, database records, or remote object storage (S3/GCS).
  • Once an audio packet is transcribed or discarded by our local energy voice-activity detector (VAD), the binary audio buffer is permanently erased from memory.

2. Data We Collect and Process

A. Transcript Excerpts: Short textual snippets (capped at a maximum of 160 characters) surrounding detected scam trigger phrases. These excerpts are stored with 256-bit encryption and are automatically purged after 7 days.

B. Consented Family Voice Embedding: If a family caregiver opts into the Cloned Voice Intervention feature, a mathematical voice embedding and pre-rendered emergency warning audio clips are generated. This requires explicit caregiver consent and a 3-phrase randomized liveness reading. You can delete your voice embedding and all pre-rendered clips at any time via the Guardian app with instantaneous deletion.

C. Guardian Account Data: Phone number or email for authentication, household nickname, paired elder device tokens, and optional Telegram chat IDs for receiving push alerts.

3. Third-Party Subprocessors

Kavach partners exclusively with trusted sovereign infrastructure providers adhering to Indian data localization standards. Speech-to-text and voice cloning are processed through Gnani.ai data centers located within the Republic of India. No transcript or voice data is transferred across international borders.

4. Your Rights Under DPDP Act 2023

As a Data Principal under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, you have the right to:

  • Request summary and full export of personal data processed by Kavach.
  • Request instantaneous erasure of your account, elder profiles, and voice embeddings.
  • Withdraw consent for passive monitoring or voice cloning at any moment.
  • Lodge a grievance with our designated Grievance Redressal Officer.
Contact Grievance Redressal

For any privacy inquiries or to exercise your DPDP rights, email grievance@kavach.ai.

Kavach

Kavach listens on a dedicated second device when you take a call on speaker. We do not tap, record, or intercept telco lines.
